verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships official SDKs: the open-source Python framework, which a runtime probe confirmed installs and imports from PyPI (pipecat-ai 1.8.1), and the Pipecat Clients family of SDKs for web and mobile apps, including pre-built React components. The client docs say these SDKs handle real-time transport, session management, and messaging/events. Missing for 10: the client SDK platforms are not enumerated beyond 'web and mobile', and there is no hands-on or independent evidence for the client SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Pipecat Clients are a family of SDKs that connect users to your Pipecat agents through web and mobile applications. They handle real-time audio/video transport, session management, and provide messaging and events for building responsive voice AI interfaces.
pypi pipecat-ai 1.8.1 (BSD-2 OSS) installs and `import pipecat` succeeds with no key, printing its startup banner
Open source Python framework for building voice and multimodal AI pipelines.
Pre-built React components for voice AI interfaces.
